g.text: Tagline: See what a carbon claim is really worth.
Value line: Type a company. See the credits it retired, how many research says are likely real, what it reports
emitting, and what independent estimates see.
Headline facts: about 1 in 5 researched tonnes likely real (19.4%, range 2.4–68.8%, flat since 2020); 40% of tonnes
name no buyer; 4.5% carry the ICVCM quality label; reported and independent emissions differ 2–3×.
Proof line: Every check is on the record. Nobody can edit it later.
